question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 05 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: Config change increased the pool size, leading to connection exhaustion.
why_chain: Config change increased search db.pool_size from 50 to 5.
Connection pool size reduction led to exhaustion during high request volume.
High request volume caused the connection pool to exhaust, resulting in latency increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: External dependency failure caused the latency increase.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence of external service failure or slowdown.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Infrastructure issue caused the latency increase.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence of network or server issues.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Data quality issues caused the latency increase.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence of bad input data.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Increased request volume caused the connection pool to exhaust.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for service search rose from 140 ms to 290 ms (+107%), with a change point at 2026-03-05T03:15:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service search: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.02).
At the same time, request volume for service search stayed about the same (2514 per 5 min before, 2741 per 5 min after, +9%).
At the same time, error rate for service search rose (0.40% before, 0.62% after, +53%).
Changed search db.pool_size from 50 to 5 (all regions) (search; 2 min before the change; record R011; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
search: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (search, eu-west; 3 min after the change; record R012; fit: describes a symptom, not a change)
p95 latency above SLO on search (search; 15 min after the change; record R013; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
search: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (search, ap-south; 20 min after the change; record R014; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
search: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (search, us-east; 26 min after the change; record R015; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (config_changes) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the config change to restore the original pool size of 50.
